recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the core source portion of FHIR-46178 while preserving the separate tooling/display-selection concern for tooling maintainers if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-46178 asked to correct Common Languages typos, wrong English/base designations, and missing German translations; Jira is Applied/Persuasive for R6 with a resolution to update ValueSet values where applicable and leave some display-selection behavior to tooling.
initial_application: Git commit 502f2d64666dccef3f8d18d4faeba79afc1b1751 applied the issue to source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml, including the bs-BA English typo and most German designations, but left el-GR with a leading blank, pa with the region name Punjab as the German language display, and sk-SK with Slovakien instead of Slowakei.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-08-19 characterize the ticket as an Additional Designations and Language Displays table issue with a tooling aspect. Later Common Languages maintenance, including FHIR-49796, reorganized designation usage and added Hebrew values without resolving these three German source literals. The edited file defines http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages and is referenced by current build inputs and bindings.
reconciliation: Changed only source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml: el-GR German designation now reads Griechisch (Griechenland), pa German designation now reads Punjabi, and sk-SK German designation now reads Slowakisch (Slowakei). English Slovakian labels were left unchanged because they were outside the seed correction and have existed separately from this German-translation issue.
source_changes: source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml: corrected el-GR de designation from " Griechisch (Griechenland)" to "Griechisch (Griechenland)".
source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml: corrected pa de designation from "Punjab" to "Punjabi".
source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml: corrected sk-SK de designation from "Slowakisch (Slovakien)" to "Slowakisch (Slowakei)".

related_jiras.note: Later Hebrew/Common Languages maintenance rewrote the same ValueSet designation structure but did not decide or fix the remaining FHIR-46178 German designation typos.
